comments.author: jcfrei
comments.story: The search for extraterrestrial life as we don’t know it
comments.why: Used as example of convergent evolution toward crab-like forms.
comments.text: Counterpoint: Alien life will probably look very similar to life on earth. If you look at evolution then countless species have evolved into something crab-like: [VIDEO] Turns out that their form is pretty good for survival. While biology can take on a myriad of forms, the competitive nature of life will weed out a lot of them. And since the rules for biochemistry are the same across the universe similar traits that are beneficial here will probably be beneficial there.
